Photo 1: Closed laptop lid, silver, with HP logo centered. Handwritten note on top-left corner: 'HP 450 G6, 256 SSD, 8GB, Core i5, 8th Gen'.
Photo 2: Front view of open laptop, screen off, HP logo on bezel, keyboard and trackpad visible. Intel sticker on bottom-right of palm rest.
All photos show a clean, silver HP laptop with no visible damage. Watermarks from 'VICKY COMPUTERS EMAB' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 handwritten note explicitly states 'HP 450 G6'.
Photo 1 note says '256 SSD', but no internal photo or system info to confirm. Cannot verify remotely.
Seller says '8GB SSD' — this is a clear error. SSD is storage, not RAM. RAM is typically 8GB. Photo 1 note says '8GB', but does not specify if RAM or SSD. The claim as written is incorrect.
Photo 1 note says 'Core i5, 8th Gen', but no system info or sticker confirms this. Intel sticker visible in photos 0 and 2, but no model number or generation shown.
Photos show no visible damage, but no close-ups of screen, hinges, or ports. No proof of functionality or internal condition.
